title: What India's Services PMI Tells Us About Our Economy's Pulse
description: India's Services PMI measures the health of our vast services sector, like IT, finance, and hospitality. The latest reading for June 2026 was 57.4, down from .

faq.q: What is the "services sector" in India?
faq.a: The services sector is the largest part of India's economy, covering a vast array of activities like information technology (IT), banking and finance, insurance, real estate, trade, hotels, transport, communication, education, healthcare, and public administration.

faq.q: Who conducts the Services PMI survey?
faq.a: The HSBC India Services PMI is compiled by S&P Global, a leading global provider of ratings, benchmarks, and analytics.

faq.q: What does "seasonally adjusted" mean for the PMI?
faq.a: "Seasonally adjusted" means that the raw data has been tweaked to remove regular, predictable seasonal influences, like increased business during festivals or a slowdown during monsoon. This helps provide a clearer picture of the underlying economic trend.

faq.q: Does the Services PMI affect the stock market?
faq.a: While the PMI is not a direct stock market indicator, strong or weak PMI data can influence investor sentiment and expectations about corporate earnings and economic growth, which can in turn affect market movements.

The Composite PMI combines the data from both the Manufacturing PMI and the Services PMI to give an overall picture of the private sector economy (both goods and services production). The HSBC India Composite PMI for June 2026 slipped to 57.1 from 59.3 in May.
